name: com.exploreworldai.legal/novacopilot
title: NovaCopilot
description: Source-bound EU regulatory answers (GDPR, AI Act, DORA, NIS2) with hash receipts; x402 USDC on Base.

tools.name: article_question
tools.description: Returns a one to two sentence answer quoted verbatim from the official EU article text, a spoken source line to read aloud, the permanent ID, source status and the official EUR-Lex link. Example: act=ai-act-2024-1689, article=50, question=vad-sager. Free.

act.description: Act slug, e.g. gdpr-2016-679 or ai-act-2024-1689.

tools.name: search_legal_sources
tools.description: Literal search across the register: Swedish statutes (SFS), guiding decisions from HD and HFD, EU acts (CELEX), US rules (CFR/USC) and finance glossary terms. Returns identifiers, titles and official source URLs. No generated text.

query.description: Search term, statute number, case reference or CELEX id.

area.description: Restrict Swedish statutes to one competence area.

tools.name: get_legal_source
tools.description: Fetch one row from the register by its layer and identifier: a Swedish statute (se), a guiding decision (praxis), an EU act (eu), a US rule (us) or a finance glossary term (finance). Includes identifiers, dates, official source URL and related sources.

layer.description: Which register layer the identifier belongs to.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Daily digest of new and updated EU and US judgments plus changed pages since a date. Call once per day with the returned `next` address instead of refetching the corpus; use the `sync` cursor feed for continuous updates.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to yesterday.

tools.name: evidence_questions
tools.description: Depth in steps for one provision, e.g. statute:regulation-2016-679-eu#art-32. Call without question for relation counts and the three questions; then call with question=sanction, change or precedent for a counted one-sentence answer. Each extra call narrows the answer. The linked judgments, decisions and authorities themselves require a key (x-partner-key) on the API. Free.

tools.name: network_status
tools.description: Live, aggregated operating data: requests in the last 24 h and 7 d (verified fetchers separate from signature only), API median and p95 latency, success share, evidence graph size and nightly run state, monitoring job state and a hash-chained daily receipt you can recompute. Counts requests, not people. Free.

tools.name: unlock_evidence_graph
tools.description: Shows how many evidence relations are locked for a canonical object and returns a ready usage key plus a one-click payment link (prepaid USD balance, no account). The key activates after confirmed payment; then send it as x-partner-key to /api/public/v1/evidence-graph.

object.description: Evidence object id, e.g. statute:regulation-2016-679-eu#art-6. Optional.

tools.name: consequence
tools.description: Source-bound consequence answer filtered by topic (gdpr, ai-act, dora, nis2, mica), type (incl. cross-relations), one of 36 sector slugs (e.g. fintech, saas, hr-tech), country, company size and language (sv, en, de, fr, it, es, zh). size=brief (~100 tokens) and standard (~250 tokens) are free; size=deep costs $0.05 from a prepaid developer key and adds relations and the decision path. Every answer carries core_sha256 and Source: NovaCopilot. For topic=ai-act pass use_case and role (AI Act follows use and role, not sector); modified=true applies the Art. 25 wrapper rule. Sector suites with honest per-sector status: https://legal.exploreworldai.com/en/novacopilot/sector-suites.json

sector.description: Sector slug; resolves to a core sector. banking (Banking & Credit Institutions) -> banking; fintech (FinTech & Digital Banking) -> banking; payments (Payment Service Providers) -> banking; crypto (Crypto-Asset Service Providers) -> banking; wealth-management (Asset & Wealth Management) -> banking; lending (Consumer Credit & Lending) -> banking; insurance (Insurance & Reinsurance) -> insurance; insurtech (InsurTech & Digital Insurance) -> insurance; pension (Occupational & Private Pensions) -> insurance; healthcare (Healthcare Providers & Hospitals) -> health; medtech (Medical Devices & MedTech) -> health; pharma (Pharmaceuticals & Biotech) -> health; healthtech (Digital Health & Telemedicine) -> health; saas (B2B & B2C SaaS) -> any; ai-vendor (AI Model & System Providers) -> any; cloud (Cloud & Hosting Infrastructure) -> any; cybersecurity (Cybersecurity & Managed Security) -> any; telecom (Telecommunications & ISP) -> any; adtech (AdTech & Digital Marketing) -> any; ecommerce (E-Commerce & Online Retail) -> any; retail (Retail & Consumer Goods) -> any; marketplace (Online Marketplaces & Platforms) -> any; gaming (Video Games & Interactive Media) -> any; travel (Travel, Aviation & Hospitality) -> any; manufacturing (Manufacturing & Industrial) -> any; automotive (Automotive & Mobility) -> any; energy (Energy, Utilities & Grid) -> any; logistics (Logistics, Shipping & Supply Chain) -> any; construction (Construction & Real Estate) -> any; hr-tech (HR Tech & Recruitment) -> any; legaltech (LegalTech & Compliance Software) -> any; edtech (EdTech & Online Education) -> any; consulting (Management & IT Consulting) -> any; media (Media, Publishing & News) -> any; public-sector (Public Administration & Municipalities) -> any; any (All Sectors / General Business) -> any

use_case.description: AI Act only: e.g. recruitment-screening, credit-scoring, chatbot, general-purpose-model.

role.description: AI Act only: provider, deployer, importer, distributor, gpai-provider. Default deployer.

modified.description: AI Act only: sold under own name, substantially modified or repurposed (Art. 25(1)).
